question: 平台目前一共有多少注册用户？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users

question: 每个城市的用户数量分别是多少，按数量从高到低排列？
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY city ORDER BY user_count DESC

question: 2025年5月的订单总数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-05-01' AND order_date < '2025-06-01'

question: 哪个商品类目的销售额最高？
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS gmv FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 1

question: 每个月的订单量趋势是怎样的？
gold_sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 订单状态分布情况如何？
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: 剔除已取消订单后，平均每笔订单金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'

question: 下单次数最多的前5位用户是谁？
gold_sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: 注册后从未下过单的用户有多少个？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.id IS NULL

question: 已取消订单占全部订单的百分比是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) FROM orders

question: 库存最少的5个商品是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT name, stock FROM products ORDER BY stock ASC LIMIT 5

question: 每个类目下有多少个商品？
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category

question: 列出所有用户的姓名和手机号。
gold_sql: SELECT name, phone FROM users

question: 卖得最畅销（按销量计）的商品是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 1

question: 杭州用户在2025年下半年的订单总金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE u.city = '杭州' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01'

question: 平均每笔订单包含多少件商品？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_qty), 2) FROM (SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question: 只下过一次单的用户有多少个？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)

question: 哪些商品的价格高于所有商品的平均价格？
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products)

question: 每个用户最近一次下单是什么时候？
gold_sql: SELECT u.name, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY last_order_date DESC

question: 平台2025年的总销售额（GMV，不含已取消订单）是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'
